stories.title: Aparna skips meeting amid divorce dispute row:Chairperson of Women's Commission says, 'If she ask for help, then we will talk'
stories.summary: Amid the ongoing divorce dispute between Aparna Yadav and her husband Prateek Yadav, Aparna did not attend a scheduled meeting of the Uttar Pradesh State Women’s Commission on Wednesday. Addressing the issue, Commission Chairperson Babita Singh Chauhan said the matter is personal and the commission will step in only if a formal complaint or request for help is made. Aparna absent from official meeting Babita Singh Chauhan made the remarks while speaking to Dainik Bhaskar after a meeting with officials of the Social Welfare Department. Aparna Yadav, who is the Vice-Chairperson of the State Women’s Commission, was not present at the meeting. Chauhan said Aparna Yadav is an educated and capable woman who can handle her personal matters on her own. “If she seeks help or files a complaint with the Women’s Commission, we will certainly look into it,” she said. Purpose of the meeting explained Explaining the purpose of the meeting, the commission chair said such reviews are held every month with different departments to understand welfare schemes meant for women and to ensure their effective implementation. “These meetings help identify gaps in implementation so that the benefits of schemes reach women who truly need them,” Chauhan said, adding that coordination between departments is essential. On Prateek Yadav’s social media posts When asked about Prateek Yadav’s social media posts announcing divorce, Chauhan said it was a private matter. “Until any formal complaint is made, the commission has no role to play,” she stated. KGMU controversy resolved On questions related to a previous controversy at King George’s Medical University (KGMU), where doctors had reportedly demanded an FIR against Aparna Yadav, Chauhan said it was a misunderstanding that has now been resolved through discussions between the vice-chancellor and Aparna. Regarding the alleged vandalism incident at KGMU, Chauhan said it was neither entirely right nor entirely wrong, suggesting that better communication could have prevented the situation. No comment on Avimukteshwaranand notice Responding to questions about a government notice issued to Avimukteshwaranand, Chauhan said she was not familiar with the matter and had never met him. She added that only those directly responsible should comment on such issues. Aparna meets party leaders at home Although Aparna did not attend the official meeting, she met party leaders at her Lucknow residence. Former MLC Arvind Tripathi Guddu shared pictures of the meeting on social media. Now read the matter related to Aparna Yadav... Prateek Yadav announces divorce on Instagram Prateek Yadav, son of Samajwadi Party founder Mulayam Singh Yadav from his second wife Sadhna Gupta, announced on Instagram that he would be divorcing Aparna Yadav. He made two posts within eight hours, accusing Aparna of damaging family relationships and being driven by ambition and fame. The posts were strongly worded and emotional. Long-standing marital strain According to family sources, tension between Aparna and Prateek began in 2022, when Aparna left the Samajwadi Party and joined the BJP against Prateek’s wishes. Prateek had also posted similar allegations on social media on 5 February 2025, but later deleted them. Following the recent posts, neither Aparna nor Prateek has responded to phone calls. Aparna’s brother claimed the social media account may have been hacked and said a statement would be issued soon. Neither Akhilesh Yadav nor the Samajwadi Party has officially commented on the matter. Personal and Political background Aparna Yadav, born Aparna Bisht, hails from a family originally from Uttarakhand. She married Prateek Yadav on 4 December 2011 after a long relationship that began in 2001. The couple has two daughters. Aparna studied in the UK and entered politics with the Samajwadi Party. She contested the 2017 assembly elections but lost. After being denied a ticket in 2022, she joined the BJP, becoming the first member of the Mulayam Singh Yadav family to switch parties. She was later appointed Vice-Chairperson of the UP State Women’s Commission. Prateek Yadav is the half-brother of former Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Akhilesh Yadav. He and Aparna currently live on Vikramaditya Marg in Lucknow, though both were reportedly out of the city at the time the social media posts surfaced. The situation continues to develop, with public attention focused on both the political and personal dimensions of the dispute.

stories.title: Birthday girl opens fire on youth in Gorakhpur:Man Injured outside liquor shop; accused linked to stolen THAR
stories.summary: A birthday celebration turned violent in the Cantt area on Tuesday evening when a young woman allegedly fired a pistol during an argument, leaving a man injured. The woman, identified as Anshika, was celebrating her birthday on the roadside with friends when a man known to her arrived. An argument escalated into a scuffle, during which a pistol went off and the bullet struck the man’s driver. The injured victim has been admitted to hospital. Police detain woman and two companions Locals detained the woman and her two companions and handed them over to police. Investigators later revealed that the accused was already wanted in connection with a THAR vehicle theft case registered three months ago. See 2 pictures- Now know the full matter in detail Anshika is originally from Harpurbudhat. She lives in a rented room in Singhariya. Her family has distanced themselves from her due to her expensive lifestyle and habit of hanging out with friends. Wearing expensive clothes, changing new mobile phones, and spending time with friends are Anshika's interests. Tuesday (January 20) was Anshika's birthday. She went near Model Shop by car with her friends. She was celebrating her birthday with her friends. At that time, a young man named Vishal Mishra was passing by with his 3 friends Amitabh Nishad, Shailesh, and Sandeep. Upon seeing Anshika, they stopped there. When Vishal went near her, an argument started between them over something. According to police, Vishal suspected that Anshika was frequently taking his wife out with her. Both were fighting over this matter. When things escalated, Anshika pulled out a pistol she was carrying in anger. During the scuffle, the gun went off. The bullet hit Vishal's friend Amitabh Nishad in the stomach. Chaos ensued after the shooting. Amitabh was taken to a nearby hospital. From there, he was referred to the medical college. Meanwhile, people surrounded Anshika and her friends who were trying to flee. Police took Anshika, Vishal and another youth into custody. A pistol was also recovered from them. Expensive habits led to crime, has trapped many police officers Police investigation revealed that Anshika became a criminal for expensive habits. She has trapped 8 policemen including a city station in-charge in her web. Some policemen had given her money fearing defamation. Though complaints were being received against Anshika, police were unable to take action due to lack of solid evidence. Late Tuesday evening, police caught her in the firing case. Police have found important evidence related to criminal activities from her possession including - pistol, assault videos etc. Police are making these part of their investigation. Amitabh is a resident of Jungle Sikri The injured Amitabh Nishad is a resident of Jungle Sikri bypass in Khorabar police station area. He is a driver for a nursing home manager. After the incident, police arrived and seized CCTV footage from the surrounding area. FIR was filed against Anshika 3 months ago in THAR theft case Cantt CO Yogendra Kumar Singh said - FIR was registered against Anshika and her 6 associates on October 12, 2025 for stealing THAR and putting fake number plate on it. Chandan Narayan, who lives in Nonhara of Ghazipur, had alleged in his complaint to Khorabar police that Anshika and her associates roam around with fake number plates on THAR stolen from Delhi. Police had arrested Priya Pravas Dubey alias Vicky from Doramha, Barhalganj near Vanaspati intersection and Akash Verma alias Bunty from Barahaj Bazaar, Deoria on October 13 in this case and sent them to jail. Search was ongoing for Anshika and 4 other accused. During investigation, 4 fake number plates were found in the car, of which two were from Haryana, one from Bihar and one from Gorakhpur. During interrogation, the accused revealed that they had rented the car from Delhi in September and fled with it. Accused had fled with the rented THAR Police officials said that Anshika had gone to Delhi with friends in September, 2025. They had rented the THAR from there, which they fled with. Fearing arrest, they were speeding around the city with fake number plates. After the arrest of two accomplices, Anshika had gone underground. She had stopped at a model shop with her companions to buy alcohol. Meanwhile, a fight broke out in which Amitabh got shot. Investigation is also underway regarding where she got the pistol from.

stories.title: Wife gets husband killed by lover in Lucknow:Accused befriended victim, made him drink alcohol, then slit his throat while riding motorcycle; both arrested
stories.summary: In a shocking incident in Lucknow, a woman allegedly got her husband murdered with the help of her lover. Police on Wednesday arrested both the wife and her lover and claimed to have solved the murder case within a day. According to the police, the accused lover, Ramteerth, first made the victim, Pradeep, drink alcohol. Later, while travelling in a moving vehicle, Ramteerth slit Pradeep’s throat, killing him on the spot. The murder took place on Tuesday night. Couple lived in rented house Pradeep lived with his wife Pooja in a rented house in Utarathiya village under the PGI police station area. Ramteerth, the main accused, lived in a nearby house. Police said Ramteerth and Pooja were in an illicit relationship. Ramteerth frequently visited Pradeep’s house, during which the affair developed. Dispute led to murder Pradeep had objected to the relationship between his wife and Ramteerth. This led to frequent disputes, and Ramteerth started holding a grudge against Pradeep. On Tuesday, Ramteerth found an opportunity and attacked Pradeep from behind on a moving bike, slitting his throat. Pradeep died after bleeding profusely. Both accused in police custody Police have arrested Pooja and Ramteerth and are questioning them further. Officials said further investigation is underway to establish the full sequence of events and gather additional evidence in the case. The bike was stained with blood, and splashes were found on the polythene. The deceased's bike was found parked at the crime scene, covered in blood. It is being speculated that the murder took place near the bike. A plastic sheet was found tied to the bike's handle, containing wrapped rolls. The plastic sheet was found stained with blood. Police are also investigating whether the rolls tied in the plastic sheet have any connection to the murder. Police detained 2 youths Upon receiving information, ADCP South Ralapalli Vasanth Kumar and ACP Gosaiganj Rishabh Yadav arrived at the scene, inspected it, and conducted an investigation. Officials stated that two suspicious individuals have been taken into custody and are being interrogated. Youth sitting on the back of the bike committed the murder Eyewitnesses claim that the youth sitting on the back of the bike committed the murder, who was caught by people present at the spot and handed over to the police. Two videos related to the incident are also going viral on social media, in which it is claimed that the youth seen in the video is the murder accused. The accused youth is said to be a resident of Amethi district. Investigation on several angles including love affair After the murder, the police conducted a search operation at the crime scene and its surroundings until late at night. The murder weapon was searched for in Shaheed Path service lane, bushes, and nearby empty plots. The police team scoured the ground and roadside areas with the help of torches and mobile lights, but no significant clue was found. Police say that the detained individuals are being interrogated. The investigation is being conducted keeping in mind love affairs, personal enmity, and other criminal aspects. The motive for the murder has not yet come to light. Father Lakhan Singh said that he received information from the police that his son Pradeep had been murdered. Pradeep had returned from the village just two days ago. stories.title: UP vision document ready with 9.8 million suggestions:6 resolutions adopted at Presiding Officers’ Conference; minimum 30 sitting days mandatory in panchayats
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Tuesday announced that the state’s Vision Document for Developed India–Developed Uttar Pradesh is ready, having been prepared through a wide-ranging participatory process involving 500 public representatives and 500 intellectuals, along with grassroots-level surveys across all 75 districts. Addressing the closing ceremony of the 86th All India Presiding Officers Conference, he said the exercise received nearly 98 lakh public suggestions following extensive district-level interactions. Three day conference concludes with adoption of six resolutions Key Points from CM Yogi’s Address 1. Voice of the Last Person Must Be Heard CM Yogi said the legislature ensures representation of even those at the lowest rung of society. “It is through the legislature that justice is delivered in its true sense. Government schemes must help in building an equitable society,” he said, noting that healthy dialogue between agreement and disagreement strengthens democracy. 2. Legislature Is the Foundation of Democracy Calling legislatures the basic unit of Indian democracy, the Chief Minister said they play a vital role not only in law-making but also in shaping the nation’s overall development roadmap. He highlighted the constitutional ideals of justice, equality and sovereignty as the guiding principles of Indian democracy. 3. Question Hour Reforms Inspired by Parliament CM Yogi recalled his experience as a five-time Lok Sabha member and emphasised the importance of training and procedural discipline. He said that earlier only two or three members could raise questions during Question Hour in the UP Assembly. Following Parliament’s model, the system was improved, enabling 20 questions to be taken up, enhancing participation and accountability. 4. Parliament Connects India’s Shared Faith Despite diversity in appearance, food habits and clothing, CM Yogi said India is united by one faith and one emotion. Parliament serves as the strongest platform to connect this shared belief. He reiterated that India has one of the world’s oldest democratic traditions, with village-level governance systems existing centuries before modern institutions. 5. Active Participation by UP MLAs The Chief Minister highlighted extensive debates on Developed India–Developed Uttar Pradesh and Self-Reliant India–Self-Reliant Uttar Pradesh, noting that 377 MLAs participated, many staying overnight in the House to present suggestions. 6. Minimum 30 Sitting Days Must Be Mandatory He reiterated that legislatures should function for at least 30 days a year, and this practice must extend to local self-governance institutions to strengthen democratic accountability at the grassroots. 7. Vision Document Prepared Through Public Participation CM Yogi said the vision document was prepared with the involvement of retired chief secretaries, additional chief secretaries, principal secretaries, vice-chancellors, educators, scientists and experts. After workshops, teams visited all 75 districts to collect feedback, resulting in 98 lakh public suggestions. “House Time Is Valuable, Deadlock Is Not Democracy”: CM Yogi CM Yogi stressed that continuous disruption in legislatures is not appropriate and undermines democratic values. “The House is meant for discussion and dialogue. Its time is extremely valuable. Deadlock and chaos should not happen inside the House,” he said, adding that efforts would be made to resolve issues through dialogue with all political parties. He underlined the need for transparent and accountable constitutional institutions, with greater public participation at every level. He also called for the minimum 30-day sitting rule to be implemented not only in Parliament and Assemblies but also in municipal bodies, gram panchayats, district panchayats and area panchayats. What the Lok Sabha Speaker and Rajya Sabha Deputy Chairman said... Democratic values strengthened under Yogi’s leadership Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla said that democratic values in Uttar Pradesh have strengthened under CM Yogi Adityanath’s leadership, alongside improvements in infrastructure and law and order. He said discussions at the conference brought institutions closer to the public by focusing on transparency and accountability. stories.title: High-speed car hits tree, 2 friends die:B-Pharma students were returning from party in Kanpur, 2 injured
stories.summary: The havoc of speed was seen in Kanpur after midnight on Tuesday. A car running at a speed of about 100 miles per hour went out of control and crashed into a roadside tree. The collision was so severe that the car was shattered. Two B.Pharma students died in the accident, while 3 others were seriously injured. The accident happened on Panki Road in the Kalyanpur police station area. Its CCTV has also come to light. In the video, the car can be seen coming at high speed. Four friends were in the car, who were going from Panki towards Kalyanpur. One died on the spot, another breathed his last in hospital In the accident, Pratham Pandey (24) died on the spot. Meanwhile, seriously injured Akash Yadav (25) was first taken to a private hospital. From here, due to a critical condition, he was referred to Regency Hospital. During treatment, Akash also passed away late at night. The two injured are undergoing treatment at a private hospital. Friends were returning from a party During police questioning, Aryan said that all friends had gone to meet a friend who studies at Narayana. They had dinner together at a hotel, and afterwards four people were returning in the same car. After crossing the Panki canal, the car lost balance. Near Awas Vikas-3, the car suddenly went out of control. Pratham Pandey, who was driving the car, died on the spot, while Akash Yadav, who was sitting in front, died during treatment. Satyam and Aryan were seriously injured. Upon receiving the information, the Kalyanpur police sent the bodies for post-mortem. Police say that preliminary investigation reveals speeding as the cause of the accident. The entire matter is also being investigated based on CCTV footage.

stories.title: Sambhal violence mastermind Sharik Satha’s house sealed:Property attachment begins; 100 police personnel arrive with drums, area turns into cantonment
stories.summary: The attachment proceedings have begun against the Sambhal violence mastermind and notorious absconding gangster Sharik alias Satha. Police took action against Satha following court orders. From 11 AM, over 100 police personnel from 5 police stations - Nakhasa, Raisatti, Sambhal Kotwali, Hayatnagar, and AHTU reached Satha's house. The entire area around the house located in Mohalla Hindupura Kheda Pajaya of Nakhasa police station area has been turned into a cantonment. Police administration is announcing the action by beating drums in the area. ASP North Kuldeep Singh, Asmoli CO Kuldeep Kumar, Sambhal Tehsildar Dhirendra Kumar Singh, Lekhpal Gyanesh Kumar, Rahul Kumar Dhariwala, and several other officials are present at the spot. According to police, Satha is India's biggest auto lifter with over 60 cases registered against him. He used to get more than 300 luxury vehicles stolen in a year. Currently, he is running his crime network while sitting in Dubai. Attachment proceedings begin... The planning for the Sambhal violence was made while sitting in Dubai... Got passport made with fake name-address Superintendent of Police Krishna Bishnoi had said that Sharik is wanted for violence. During the investigation, police found his passport, which was issued in Delhi on August 18, 2020, in the name of Hussain, son of Khwaja Sharik Hussain. It had the address B-5609, Street No. 115, Sant Nagar in Burari, Delhi. When the Sambhal police reached that address for investigation, it was found that Sharik never lived there. This clearly shows that he got his passport made with a fake name and address by hiding more than 60 cases registered against him. According to immigration records, about a month after getting the passport, he went to Dubai in September 2020 and has not returned to India since then. Claims of Gold smuggling and ISI links Weapons factory conspiracy at India-Nepal border The investigation also revealed that Salim Pistol from Delhi's Jaffrabad met Sharik Satha in Dubai. Salim is notorious for weapons smuggling from Pakistan. He was caught smuggling weapons and gold in Nepal this year. Investigation agencies claim that Sharik Satha and Salim Pistol were planning to open the biggest illegal weapons factory on the India-Nepal border. Before this could happen, Salim was caught in Nepal, while Sharik is still absconding in Dubai. Now know how the Sambhal violence erupted... Violence broke out during the survey of a mosque in Sambhal on November 24, 2024. On November 19, 2024, a claim was filed in the Civil Senior Division Court Chandausi stating that the Shahi Jama Masjid of Sambhal was the Sri Harihar Temple. On the court's order, the first phase of the survey was conducted that same evening. The second phase of the survey was to be conducted on November 24, 2024, when thousands of people gathered. Violence erupted while protesting the survey. There was stone pelting and firing on the police, in which five people died. Police-administration also injured in violence During the Sambhal violence, SP Krishna Kumar Bishnoi, then CO Anuj Chaudhary, Deputy Collector, along with 29 policemen, were injured. A total of 12 FIRs were registered at Sambhal Kotwali and Thana Nakhasa. SP MP Ziaur Rahman Barq and SP MLA Iqbal Mahmood's son Suhail Iqbal, along with many others, were named in these. A total of more than 2200 people were accused. 134 accused sent to jail, main conspirator absconding

stories.title: Ram Mandir Trust Chief Nritya Gopal Das's health deteriorates:Swami has not eaten anything for last 36 hours; referred to Medanta Hospital Lucknow
stories.summary: The health of Mahant Nrityagopal Das, head of the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Trust in Ayodhya, has worsened. After his condition deteriorated, retired doctor S.K. Pathak of Shri Ram Hospital examined him. The Mahant had not eaten anything for the past 36 hours and was experiencing continuous vomiting and diarrhea. He has now been referred to Medanta Hospital in Lucknow. His successor, Mahant Kamalnayan Das, accompanied him to Medanta on Wednesday afternoon. Mahant Nrityagopal Das is also the head of the Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi Nyas and has millions of disciples across India and abroad. Eyewitness account and hospital response The administrative officer of Shri Ram Hospital, Y.P. Singh, said that after receiving information about the Mahant’s deteriorating health, a team of doctors examined him. He was then sent to Medanta Hospital with a medical team and an ambulance. Mahant Kamalnayan Das is accompanying him. Further updates will be available after the medical reports are received. Past health issues During the COVID-19 pandemic five years ago, Mahant Nrityagopal Das had contracted the virus while attending the Shri Krishna Janmotsav in Mathura. Since then, his health has fluctuated. He has been admitted to Medanta, Lucknow, multiple times, including in 2020 and September 2024. Recent visits and public engagements Earlier, Mahant Nrityagopal Das visited the ashram of Saint Premanand Maharaj in Mathura-Vrindavan on 27 November 2025. He received a grand welcome from the saint, who performed rituals including offering his seat, garlanding, and waving the ceremonial aarti. During this visit, Mahant Nrityagopal Das emphasized the importance of devotion, stating that no work can succeed without the grace of God. About Mahant Nrityagopal Das Born on 11 June 1938 in Kerhala village, Mathura district, Mahant Nrityagopal Das completed his schooling in 1953 and enrolled in a commerce college in Mathura, where he turned towards spirituality. At the age of 12, he moved from Mathura to Ayodhya and became a disciple of Mahant Ram Manohar Das. He earned a Shastri degree from Banaras Sanskrit University. In 1965, he became the Mahant of Shri Maniram Das Chhawni (Chhoti Chhawni) in Ayodhya. He was elected head of the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Nyas in 2003 and currently serves as the chief of the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust. He has been a key figure in the Ram Mandir movement and its construction and is regarded as one of the country’s leading spiritual leaders, respected by all akharas across India. Medical Update Mahant Nrityagopal Das is being transported to Medanta, Lucknow, for further treatment. His condition will be monitored closely, and updates will follow once the medical team releases the reports.

stories.title: Air Force plane crashes in Prayagraj:Falls into a pond, wobbled mid-air over heart of the city; 3 km away from Magh Mela | VIDEO
stories.summary: An Indian Air Force training aircraft crashed in Prayagraj. The aircraft began to wobble while flying and fell into a pond. Both pilots on board the two-seater aircraft are safe. The accident occurred at around 12:20 pm on Wednesday behind KP College. This is a densely populated area in the middle of the city. There are schools and residential colonies near the pond. The site is about 3 km from the Magh Mela area. Soon after the crash, local residents rushed to the spot. Eyewitnesses said that before the aircraft crashed, both pilots bailed out using parachutes and landed in the pond. They got stuck in the marshy area and were pulled out by local people. The pond in which the aircraft fell is covered with water hyacinth on all sides. Rescue teams have reached the aircraft. The Army, fire brigade, SDRF and NDRF are present at the site. The rescue operation is ongoing. PRO Defence Wing Commander Debartho Dhar said, “The microlight aircraft developed a technical fault while taking off from Bamrauli Air Force Station at 12:15 pm.” He added, “Showing presence of mind, both pilots brought the aircraft down in a deserted area, ensuring there was no loss of life or property to civilians. A Court of Inquiry has been ordered to ascertain the cause of the accident.” IAF statement on aircraft crash For the latest update related to the IAF aircraft crash, go through the live blog...

stories.title: Student jumps from 6th floor at IIT Kanpur:Scholar lived on campus with pregnant wife, had schizophrenia, was under treatment
stories.summary: A student of IIT Kanpur committed suicide by jumping from the 6th floor of the college. The management admitted him to a private hospital, where doctors declared him dead. After this, fellow students took his body to the postmortem house. They informed that the deceased student is Swaroop Ishwar Ram, who was pursuing a PhD in Earth Science. It was reported that Ramswaroop had been troubled by a disease called schizophrenia for the past 2 years. He was undergoing treatment. On the evening of January 19, he went to see the physician. He was called on Tuesday evening. However, before that, Ramswaroop committed suicide. Ram Pratap Ishwar lives in Churu, Rajasthan. His 25-year-old son Ramswaroop Ishwaram was pursuing a PhD from IIT Kanpur. He lived in AA-21, New SBRA Building at IIT. Ishwar jumped from the 6th floor of this building on Tuesday afternoon. Ramswaroop Ishwaram lived in the college campus with his wife Manju and 3-year-old daughter Charu. His wife is also 3 months pregnant. People nearby said that he had been struggling with anxiety for a long time. Due to this, he was mentally disturbed. Ramswaroop Ishwaram was the youngest of 3 brothers. The eldest brother's name is Rampal. He has been informed about Ramswaroop's death. Supposed to visit the counselor today Ramswaroop Ishwaram's friend Rajeev said that he lived in the hostel. He had a disease called schizophrenia. At this time, the disease was in a low phase. His treatment was ongoing at IIT Kanpur. On Monday evening, we took him to the physician. Here, the physician told Ramswaroop's counselor to refer him from here. Then the counselor sent us home. Asked to come on Tuesday. Ramswaroop was supposed to visit them this evening, but he committed suicide. Meanwhile, IIT management issued a statement expressing grief over the student's death. Wrote - PhD student Ramswaroop Ishwaram was a promising researcher. He joined the institute in July 2023. In this moment of grief, the institute expresses condolences on the death of a promising researcher. DCP West says - Wife is being questioned DCP West Kasim Abidi said that the Kalyanpur police and forensic team reached the spot on information about a suicide. Evidence has been collected from the scene. Preliminary information revealed that the student was battling depression. Counseling was also done many times. The family has been informed about the death. The wife is being questioned at the police station. Second Suicide in 22 Days This is the second suicide at IIT in 22 days. Earlier, on December 29, Jai Singh Meena (26) from Ajmer, Rajasthan, had committed suicide. He was a 4th year BTech student of Biological Sciences. The student had hanged himself from a fan in Room No. 148 of Hostel No. 2. He first cut the veins in his hand, then hanged himself in the hostel room. Police found a suicide note in the room. It read - 'Sorry Everyone...'

stories.title: Vice Chancellor breaks silence on KGMU controversy case:Dr. Sonia Nityanand says, 'Dr. Ramiz expelled in 'Love Jihad' case, won't speak about Aparna Yadav
stories.summary: There was an affair between a girl and a boy. Both are adults. They had a relationship, too. Obviously, when we received a complaint from the Hindu girl, we took the strictest action within 15 days and expelled the accused student, Dr. Ramiz. This action was within the university's jurisdiction, which we took without delay. Further action needs to be taken by the local police and STF. Action will definitely be taken against the guilty based on evidence. This is what KGMU Vice Chancellor Padmashri Dr. Sonia Nityanand says. She answered questions from Dainik Bhaskar reporter regarding the love jihad-conversion case at KGMU and the disturbance caused by people who came with Women's Commission Vice Chairperson Aparna Yadav. However, she also appeared disappointed about the lack of FIR on the complaint filed by the KGMU administration. Read the key excerpts from the interview... Question - A sudden dispute emerged in KGMU campus, how do you view this? Answer.. We were absolutely right. I know that I was right, our institution was right. It certainly feels bad that such an incident happened, injustice was also done. All this was like a phase of life, which has now passed. We have collectively raised our voice against this. We have also ensured that there should be no hindrance in the treatment of patients coming to the medical university under any circumstances. Question - What was discussed during the meeting with the Chief Minister? Answer.. I presented every fact before them. Informed the CM about the complete situation. This is a government institution. Being a state government institution, they also gave full assurance regarding security. The CM assured an impartial investigation in this matter. He also expressed satisfaction over the decision to remove the accused Ramiz from the university. Question- The FIR filed by you has not been registered yet? Answer... Yes.. FIR has not been registered yet. About a week ago, our Teachers Association and Employees wanted to stop OPD services regarding this. I explained to them that stopping OPD won't get the FIR registered. We are still trying to get FIR registered against those few people who created a lot of disturbance here, so that such incidents cannot happen again in future. Question- Is Ramiz's case becoming completely Hindu-Muslim? Answer..STF is investigating this case. If there is any truth in this, they will definitely bring it forward. We had a complaint from a junior resident girl. A sexual harassment complaint was filed by her side. The accused was found guilty in the Vishaka investigation. Police have registered an FIR regarding the investigation of various aspects, including love jihad. Now that the investigation is with STF, the truth will come out on its own. Question...Did this incident also affect the university's working? Answer...Yes..Absolutely. We did not let patient treatment be affected. Many university-level works were impacted. On January 9th, when there was unrest in the administrative building. The MBBS students' exams were going on on the first floor. The students giving exams faced a lot of trouble due to the incident of intense commotion. Many routine works were affected. It received an A++ rating in NAAC grading. Taking a leap of 19 positions, KGMU succeeded in achieving 8th rank in the NIRF 2025 ranking. My goal is to take this progress forward. Question...Did you meet the Governor, what did they say to you? Answer.. Yes..I met with the Chancellor, Governor Madam at Raj Bhavan. I briefed her about the entire sequence of events. She said that you people should keep moving forward, don't stop your work, and the university should continue progressing in the same direction it has made progress. No obstacles or hindrances should be allowed. Question.... Dr. Wahid Ali of the Pathology Department was removed from his position last Wednesday. What is the reason behind this? Answer.. This entire incident is related to the Pathology Department. Obviously, some people will be guilty in this matter. But when STF itself is investigating this case, further action will also be taken by them. Regarding the matter related to Prof. Wahid Ali, I would say that he has not been removed from his position. For the past 10 years, he was in charge of four labs under POCT in the Pathology Department. Under the routine procedure, all faculty members of the department are made in-charge by rotation, and accordingly, new people have been given command of those labs. No one has found him guilty in this matter yet. In such a situation, it is not right to talk about taking action. As for the HOD of Pathology Department, I have said before that now STF is investigating, whoever is guilty, the investigating agency will find them out. Question- A matter related to Aparna Yadav's personal life has come to light. What would you say about that? Answer...It would not be appropriate for me to comment on this matter. This is their personal matter, so it would not be right for me to comment. Female doctor victim attempted suicide The victim female doctor, is pursuing an MD Pathology from KGMU. On December 17, she attempted suicide by taking an overdose of medicine. She was admitted to the KGMU Trauma Center in serious condition. She was discharged on December 19. The victim's father alleged that Dr. Ramiz, who is studying MD Pathology at KGMU, trapped his daughter in love jihad. He pressured her to convert to Islam for marriage. However, he is already married. In February, he had already married a Hindu girl after converting her. Complaint filed with Chief Minister and State Women's Commission The victim's father had filed a complaint with the State Women's Commission and on the Chief Minister's public hearing portal. After this, on December 22, State Women's Commission Vice Chairperson Aparna Yadav held a press conference with the victim and assured action. After the preliminary report of the Vishaka Committee was released on December 24, the KGMU administration suspended Dr. Ramiz and banned his entry into the campus. An FIR was also filed against the accused. On December 26, the Vice Chancellor formed a 7-member committee to investigate fundamentalist activities in KGMU. The accused Dr.'s parents were found to be involved. They have been arrested. Police have also arrested the accused Dr. Ramiz. A reward of 50 thousand was announced for him. The case is now being investigated by STF.

stories.title: Avimukteshwaranand warns administration to withdraw notice:Prayagraj authorities demand explanation on Swami’s self-declaration as Shankaracharya
stories.summary: A dispute that began between the administration and Swami Avimukteshwaranand over bathing arrangements during Mouni Amavasya in Prayagraj has now escalated to the issue of the Shankaracharya title. Avimukteshwaranand sent an eight-page reply to the fair administration via e-mail within 24 hours, calling the notice “arbitrary, malicious, and unconstitutional.” He stated that the Supreme Court has issued no order preventing him from retaining the position of Shankaracharya. Since the matter is pending in court, no third party has the right to comment or impose restrictions. Avimukteshwaranand also warned the administration to withdraw the notice, saying that failure to do so would invite legal action, including defamation and contempt of court. He added that such actions are tarnishing the image of the Shankaracharya. The controversy began when the fair administration issued a notice on Tuesday, citing a Supreme Court order dated 14 October 2022, questioning how he had declared himself as Shankaracharya. The matter is still under judicial consideration, and until the court decides, no one can officially assume the Shankaracharya title. The court has prohibited anyone from taking the position of Shankaracharya for the time being. Despite this, Avimukteshwaranand wrote “Shankaracharya of Jyotishpeeth” on a board in his camp, an act considered contempt of court. He performed pooja and rituals while sitting on a dharna (sit-in protest). Five Key Points of the Dispute: On Sunday (Mouni Amavasya), Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand was to be taken in a palanquin for the ceremonial bath. The police stopped him and asked him to go on foot. A scuffle occurred with his disciples when he protested. Angered by the scuffle and the palanquin being stopped, Avimukteshwaranand sat on dharna outside his camp. At midnight on Monday, Kanungo Anil Kumar arrived at the Mela to serve a notice to the Shankaracharya’s disciples. The disciples refused to accept the notice, saying nobody was present at that hour and to come in the morning. On Tuesday morning, Kanungo Anil Kumar again visited the Shankaracharya’s camp and affixed the notice at the gate. The notice was issued on behalf of the Mela authority’s vice-chairman. A dispute exists between Avimukteshwaranand and Vasudevanand regarding the Shankaracharya title at Jyotishpeeth. The matter is currently sub judice (pending in court).

stories.title: Campaign against Love Jihad underway in Prayagraj Magh Mela:Why get involved with Abdul, parents should use sticks to awaken daughters', says Harsha Richhariya
stories.summary: Devotees are returning after having holy dips at the Sangam in Prayagraj. In front, 3 people are standing with charts. One reads - Save your daughter from Love Jihad, while another reads How long will Hindus keep getting converted? The people holding these banners say they are raising awareness about Love Jihad. That's not all - there are discussions about Love Jihad throughout the fair. From Naga Sadhus to Shankaracharyas, everyone is speaking openly about this issue. Harsha Richariya, who came to the fair, even said that until now Hindus were explaining to their girls through words. Now if a stick is needed, explain with a stick. After all, why should they get involved with any Abdul? Dainik Bhaskar spoke to different people at the Magh Mela about Love Jihad discussions. What emerged raises several serious questions in many ways. Standing at Sangam with banners, police removing them The Magh Mela started in Prayagraj from January 3. Lakhs of people are taking bath in Sangam every day. Those who promote anything here believe that if the message is conveyed properly, it can easily reach millions of people. With this thought, Vipin Singh, Shivangi and Naveen came to Sangam. These people are raising awareness about love jihad. First, they were standing near the Sangam ghat with banners. However, the police asked them to move from there. After this, these people came and stood on the return path. We asked Vipin, why is all this necessary? Vipin says - Love jihad incidents are continuously increasing in the country. Such incidents are coming to light every day from every corner of the country. The pattern is the same. Wherever you look, you will see the same scene. If we all don't speak up today, there will be a lot of damage in the future. The banner in Vipin's hand reads - Save daughter, educate daughter. Daughter will study only when she is saved. First save your daughter from love jihad. First he will increase friendship, then impose restrictions Shivani Sharma from Prayagraj is also standing with a banner in hand. She says - We live in Delhi, have been in Prayagraj for the past month. In cases of Love Jihad, the biggest mistake is of the Hindu girl herself. She needs to understand that she should not meet or associate with such people. First he will speak sweet words, but later he will trap you. Then he will say you cannot do this, you cannot do that. If you refuse these things, then he will beat you. Girls need to stay away from this. The banner held by Vipin's third companion Naveen Singh is different from the other two. It reads - What unites Hindus? How long will Hindus continue to be divided? How long in Kashmir, now being divided in Bengal? Where next will Hindus be divided? Jai Shri Ram. Naveen says - We are not associated with any party or organization. Our aim is just to create awareness. Hindus are dying every day. Look at the condition of Bangladesh and Pakistan yourself. There is a campaign going on like 'Drive out Hindus-Save Country'. Blasts are happening in Delhi. Earlier they used to say that people were uneducated, but now even highly educated people are involved in this work. Shankaracharya says - Love Jihad means human trafficking Not just posters-banners, but Love Jihad has become a big issue among saints and Shankaracharya as well. Shankaracharya Swami Narendranand Saraswati of Sumer Peeth in Varanasi says - Love Jihad is a kind of human trafficking case. 10-11 lakh Hindu girls were kidnapped and then sold abroad. The property of those who are doing this should be confiscated. They should be sentenced to life imprisonment. Cruelty is necessary with the wicked. If they are not dealt with strictly, it will be dangerous. Naga Sadhu Mahant Chetan Giri of Sri Panchdashnam Ahwan Akhada has also come to the fair. Regarding love jihad, he says - Our daughters are vulnerable, anyone can persuade and mislead them. Hindus are like cows, but when provoked they become like lions. They are creating situations to disrupt other religions. They call us kafirs. But they should understand that if we resort to kafir behavior, they won't be able to survive. Harsha said - Girls now need to be disciplined with a stick Harsha Richaria, who came into discussion from Mahakumbh, is also at the fair at this time. She is vocal about love jihad. Says- There is a need to explain to our young generation, especially girls, against love jihad. There is a need to create awareness. It is my opinion that when a child starts earning, learns to make a name, learns to use social media, then they have enough knowledge to know what is right and what is wrong. But, despite this, if you get involved with some Abdul, then you are wrong. Harsha further says - All the cases that are coming at this time are not hidden from anyone. How many daughters are being targeted, this is in front of everyone. Cases are coming up from somewhere every day. There are some shortcomings in our daughters too. Now if they are not understanding even after all this happening, then they need to be explained with a stick. Because, explaining verbally has been done a lot. We are already explaining to the other person, now daughters also need to be explained. We spoke to Dr. KK Mishra, eye surgeon at Tej Bahadur Sapru Hospital, about this case of love jihad. He says - Love jihad is wrong in the sense when instead of true love, the focus is only on targeting a particular religion and acquiring girls. If that's the case, then we can categorize it as love jihad. But if someone is truly in love, considering love above everything else, then such love should not be restricted. stories.title: 'Aparna Yadav is a fighter, will stand strong':Uttarakhand family says, 'daughter’s in-laws are influential'; divorce situation unfair
stories.summary: "We don't have much information about their private life, because they are now part of a very large family and a big city. As a brother, I will definitely say that she has been very sharp and quick-witted since childhood." "Even if there is some turmoil in family life, we hope that she will stand strong. She is a fighter. Aparna is not just a daughter-in-law, but also a daughter of this village. She is a future great leader." This is what Anoop Singh Bisht, who lives in Garhbarsali village of Uttarkashi and is Aparna Yadav's elder brother, has to say. On January 19, news of the divorce between BJP leader Aparna Yadav, the younger daughter-in-law of the country's most influential 'Yadav family', and her husband, Prateek Yadav, created a stir in political corridors. Hundreds of kilometers away from Lucknow, in the quiet village of 'Garhbarsali' (Kura) in the Uttarkashi district of Uttarakhand, echoes of this news have reached. This is Aparna Yadav's ancestral village. The same village where her father, Arvind Singh Bisht, spent his childhood, and where Aparna grew up playing in its soil. Dainik Bhaskar team reached out to gauge the villagers' pulse on this issue; there was both silence and subdued concern. While the village people are not very aware of the storm in their 'daughter's' personal life, there is certainly a pain that the relationship, which was connected to a big name like Mulayam Singh Yadav, has broken down in such a way. Village celebrated Aparna's wedding Garhbarsali village, located near Uttarkashi headquarters, is known for its simplicity. Senior journalist Arvind Singh Bisht belongs to an old but influential family from this village. When his daughter Aparna Bisht (now Yadav) got married to Mulayam Singh Yadav's son Prateek, there was a celebratory atmosphere throughout the region. People felt that Lucknow's power had now directly connected to their village. But today, when news of divorce is coming, the village people are in doubt. Aparna's cousin and advocate by profession, Anoop Singh Bisht, says, "Look, Aparna Yadav spent her childhood here with us''. She often used to come here during holidays. We used to play together. She was an 'all-rounder' from the beginning. Whether it was studies, music, or drawing, she excelled in everything. She had an interest in politics since childhood." Anoop further says, "After marriage, she stayed in Lucknow with her parents. Her father, Uncle Arvind, was in a senior position at The Times of India, so she was raised in that environment. 'They are big people, these are big things...' The reaction of Anil Singh Bisht, who runs a small village shop and is related to Aparna as her brother, reflects both mountain-like innocence and pain. He says, "We only get to know what's happening through newspapers and TV''. She came once in between, when we used to be part of Uttar Pradesh. There was a prayer ceremony at her house then. She had come by helicopter. We all met her, and her behavior was very good. She had met the village people with great affection." Anil Bisht further says, "Now look, Uttarakhand is a separate state, and she is in UP politics. If she had come to Uttarakhand, perhaps something good would have happened here. As far as their divorce is concerned, it doesn't feel good to hear about it. She is a daughter of our family. What is happening, if true, is unfortunate. But sitting here in the village, what can we say about decisions being made in Lucknow?" The house that awaits their arrival Arvind Singh Bisht's ancestral house still stands proudly in the village, but it remains silent. A caretaker family lives there to look after this house. Sonu Kashyap from Haridwar and his wife have been guarding the place for the past year. Sonu Kashyap says, "Sir, we are poor people. For us, it's a big deal that because of Arvind sir and Aparna ma'am, our children are getting food. She (Aparna) came last time when there was a program in Chinyalisaur. She comes for very little time. Sometimes stays for an hour, sometimes for a day. But whenever she meets, she talks very nicely. What else do we need? For us, her coming and giving us employment is the biggest gift." 'Bridge of Development Hope and Memories' Village elder and Aparna's uncle, Dhanbir Singh Bisht, recalls old memories and tells how Aparna's father worked for the village. He says, "The road to Kura that you see today, which comes four kilometers from the Kachadu Devta temple up to the village, is the contribution of Arvind Singh Bisht. At that time, Mulayam Singh Yadav was alive, and it was his government. Arvind ji used his influence to get this road approved." Dhanbir Singh says, "Now that she (Aparna) is in such a high position, there are expectations. But the truth is that she has become a part of Lucknow now. She rarely comes here. Her father comes every year to worship his patron deity, but Aparna is rarely able to come due to her busy schedule. What can we say about the divorce news? The air in big cities is different. We just know that she is bringing glory to our village's name." On the village road, another elderly person and lawyer Jagmohan Singh Bisht also appears somewhat disappointed. He says, "Distant drums sound sweet. I have seen her since childhood, and had good relations with her father. She used to live in Lucknow. When Banshilal ji was the Minister of Mountain Development, we met in Charbagh. We hoped that she would do something big for this region, bring a project. But now we have to deal with our village head; Lucknow has become a distant matter." However, Jagmohan ji does not lose hope in the end. He says, "She is in power, at a good level. If not today, then tomorrow, she will definitely do something. No one completely forgets their roots." The most prominent thing that emerged in this investigation by Dainik Bhaskar is that Garhbarsali village is emotionally connected to its 'high-profile daughter', but a practical distance has also been created.

stories.title: Judge who ordered FIR against ASP Anuj transferred:Aditya Singh appointed new CJM of Sambhal, ordered Jama Masjid survey; 14 Judges transferred in UP
stories.summary: The Allahabad High Court made a major reshuffle on Tuesday evening. 14 judges have been transferred. The list includes three district judge-level officers. The list has been issued by the Registrar Judicial Services, Rajneesh Kumar of the High Court. The shocking name in the list is Vibhanshu Sudhir, Chief Judicial Magistrate (CJM) of Sambhal. Vibhanshu had ordered FIR registration against ASP Anuj Chaudhary and 20 policemen on January 9. It is alleged that during the Sambhal violence, ASP Anuj Chaudhary and other policemen shot a young man. Vibhanshu has been sent to Sultanpur as a Civil Judge Senior Division. Aditya Singh, Civil Judge Senior Division of Chandausi, is now the new CJM of Sambhal. It was Aditya Singh who had ordered the survey on Sambhal's Sri Harihar Temple versus Shahi Jama Masjid claim. Aditya Kumar Singh has been promoted. Now know why FIR orders were issued against police personnel? Yameen, a resident of Mohalla Khaggu Sarai Anjuman in Sambhal's Nakhasa police station area, filed a petition in the CJM court on February 6, 2025. Yameen stated that his son, Alam, left home on November 24, 2024, to sell rusk (toast). When he reached the Shahi Jama Masjid area, the police shot him. Yameen had named 12 policemen, including the then CO Sambhal Anuj Chaudhary and Sambhal Kotwali Inspector Anuj Tomar, as accused. The case was heard in court on January 9, 2026. The Chief Judicial Magistrate had ordered an FIR to be filed against all police officers. Yameen's lawyer, Chaudhary Akhtar Hussain, said his client's son got treatment while hiding from the police. The court was requested to file an FIR against former CO Anuj Chaudhary, former Inspector Anuj Tomar and unknown policemen. SP KK Bishnoi had said - will appeal against the decision SP Krishna Kumar Bishnoi had said- A judicial inquiry of the violence has been completed. Therefore, this FIR will not be registered. We will appeal against the court's decision. 4 people died in violence during a survey on November 24, 2024 The Hindu side had claimed about Sambhal's Jama Masjid that it was earlier a Harihar temple, which Babur demolished in 1529 and built a mosque. A petition was filed in the Sambhal court on November 19, 2024, regarding this. On the same day, Civil Judge Senior Division Aditya Singh ordered a survey inside the mosque. The court appointed Ramesh Singh Raghav as Advocate Commissioner. The team reached the mosque at 4 PM that day for the survey. The survey was conducted for 2 hours. However, the survey was not completed that day. After this, on November 24, the survey team reached Jama Masjid. The survey was being conducted inside the mosque. Meanwhile, a large number of people gathered. The crowd threw stones at the police team. After this, violence erupted. 4 people died due to gunshot wounds. SP Krishna Kumar Bishnoi, prominent CO Anuj Chaudhary, Deputy Collector, along with 29 policemen, were injured. After the violence, police arrested 79 rioters, including 3 women. A total of 12 FIRs were registered at Sambhal Kotwali and Thana Nakhasa. FIR was registered against SP MP Ziaur Rahman Barq, SP MLA Iqbal Mahmood's son Suhail Iqbal, along with 40 named people and 2750 unknown people. On June 18, SIT filed a 1128-page chargesheet in court against 23 people, including MP Barq. However, SP MLA's son Suhail Iqbal's name is not included in the chargesheet. CJM Vibhanshu issued several orders against police personnel CJM Vibhanshu Sudhir ordered an FIR against 13 police personnel, including then-inspector Pankaj Lawania, on December 24, 2025, in the fake encounter case in Sambhal. These included 2 inspectors, 4 sub-inspectors and constables who were posted at the time of the incident. The court directed the Station House Officer of the Bahajoi police station to immediately register the case and submit a report to the court within 3 days. In the Bahajoi police station area on July 7, 2022, Omvir, Dhirendra and Avnesh were arrested during an encounter. In the case presented before the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Omvir had accused then CO Gopal Singh of staging a fake encounter. The court ordered that he should not be included in this case. Where all were posted Now see the transfer list Harendra Nath: Additional District and Session Judge (Fast Track Court) to Additional District and Session Judge / Special Judge (POCSO Act) Alka Yadav: Special Judge / Additional District and Session Judge to Additional District and Session Special Judge, Gonda Rajendra Kumar Singh: Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sitapur to Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kannauj Shraddha Bhartiya: Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kannauj, became Civil Judge, Senior Division, Kannauj Jyotsna Yadav: Civil Judge Senior Division, became Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kannauj Sneha: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kannauj, given additional charge of Secretary, District Legal Services Authority Vikas: Special Judge / Additional District and Session Judge became Additional District and Session Judge, Fast Track Court. Uruj Fatima: Additional Civil Judge (Senior Division) was made Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate. Anshu Shukla: Additional Civil Judge (Senior Division), became Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate Gaurav Prakash: Civil Judge (Senior Division), became Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sitapur Aditya Singh: Civil Judge (Senior Division) became Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sambhal Vibhanshu Sudhir: Chief Judicial Magistrate appointed as Civil Judge Senior Division, Sultanpur. Alunkrita Shakti Tripathi: Civil Judge Senior Division, became Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sultanpur Shubham Verma: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate became Civil Judge Senior Division, Sultanpur

stories.summary: Weather conditions are changing across Uttar Pradesh due to the impact of a western disturbance. With a rise in temperature, mild cold conditions persist in around 15 districts, while people have received some relief from intense cold and dense fog. According to the Meteorological Department, a spell of rain is likely to begin in the state from January 22 and may continue for five to six days. As per the Regional Meteorological Centre, rainfall will first begin in western Uttar Pradesh due to the impact of two successive active western disturbances, and may later spread across the eastern parts of the state. During this period, cloud movement will continue, and wind directions are expected to change. Easterly winds are likely to shift to westerlies, increasing moisture in the atmosphere and creating favourable conditions for rain. Weather scientist Atul Kumar Singh said that in the coming days, temperatures may fluctuate further along with rainfall. However, due to the current rise in temperature, relief from severe cold is expected to continue. The Meteorological Department has advised farmers and the general public to remain alert in view of the expected rainfall and changing weather conditions. Weather-related incidents across districts At least 15 vehicles collided with each other due to dense fog, causing significant damage to several vehicles in Bagpat. A layer of mist accompanied by cold wave conditions reduced visibility to just 50 metres in Noida. Light fog was reported in the morning. Sunshine appeared by 8 am, but the chill remained in Agra. The weather remained clear, but cold winds continued to cause shivering conditions, with people seen warming themselves around bonfires in the morning in Kanpur. Fog alert in these 15 districts today Noida, Aligarh, Bagpat, Jaunpur, Ghazipur, Varanasi, Gorakhpur, Deoria, Khalilabad, Chandauli, Mirzapur, Muzaffarnagar, Mathura, and Siddharthnagar. Why the weather has changed? The active western disturbance over north-west India is now clearly affecting Uttar Pradesh. As a result, cloud cover has increased in several parts of the state. Wind patterns have changed, with easterly winds being replaced by westerlies. This has increased moisture levels in the atmosphere and created conditions favourable for rainfall in some areas. Rainfall beneficial for wheat and pulses Agricultural experts say the expected rainfall will be beneficial for wheat, lentils, and gram crops, but may cause damage to mustard and potato crops. Farmers have been advised to closely monitor weather updates and spray pesticides on crops when necessary to prevent losses. Four-day weather forecast January 21: Weather will remain clear in both western and eastern Uttar Pradesh. Light fog may appear at a few places, but cold winds will continue, keeping the chill intact. January 22: Cloudy conditions will prevail in both western and eastern Uttar Pradesh. Light rain may occur at some places, with temperatures likely to drop by 2–3 degrees Celsius. January 23: Light fog and cloudy skies are expected in western Uttar Pradesh, with similar conditions in the eastern region. Cold winds will maintain chilly conditions. January 24: Light rainfall is likely at a few places in both western and eastern Uttar Pradesh. Fog will be mild, while cold winds may continue.

stories.title: Raebareli visit marks Rahul Gandhi's new political approach:Focuses on MGNREGA issues, ground connect after Bihar defeat; analysts see strategic shift in Congress politics
stories.summary: After Congress's crushing defeat in the Bihar Assembly elections, Rahul Gandhi's first major event was held in Raebareli. Here, he not only spoke with party workers but also inaugurated a cricket tournament. He visited the Municipal Chairman's house and met villagers at the 'Save MGNREGA Forum' in Umran village. However, this time Rahul's style seemed different. No aggressive tone, nor any 'unique' stunts. Controlled language, measured words and simple dialogue with villagers - this was Rahul's new 'mature' face. Political experts cite two reasons for this. First- Bihar elections did not accept aggression. There, Congress was reduced to just 19 seats. Second- Rahul is now crafting an image of a 'measured style' leader like his sister Priyanka Gandhi, who can also be effective in parliament. But, the question is whether Rahul's new style will be able to grow Congress? Or will this just prove to be an election slogan on the Modi government's MGNREGA 'changes'? Read Bhaskar Analysis... Rahul emphasized more on 'ground connect' Rahul Gandhi's Raebareli visit began in the morning with a dialogue with workers. During this, local SP leaders also met him. Hoardings put up at several places in the city also drew people's attention, which showed Rahul-Akhilesh as captains for the 2027 and 2029 Lok Sabha elections. Rahul met each Congress worker at the MP's residence in Raebareli. During this, he also talked to people who had come with different problems from the district. Rahul Gandhi did not forget to inquire about the Rahul Valmiki case in Fatehpur. District Congress Advocate Committee's Amaresh Bajpai said - Mistaking him for a drone thief, people had beaten Rahul Valmiki to death in Unchahar a few days ago. In this case, Rahul Gandhi himself went to Fatehpur to meet the victim's family. When he reached his parliamentary constituency, he did not forget to take an update on this case. This shows how much importance he gives to the pain of a common person. According to Amaresh Bajpai, 19 arrests have been made in this case. Bail has been rejected for 15. Bail applications for 6 are pending in the High Court. A delegation of the Bharatiya Kisan Union had also arrived to meet Rahul. Anil Verma, who was part of it, says - irrigation in the area is done through canals, but due to a lack of cleaning, water is not reaching the tail end. Also, farmers are not getting fertilisers. Even in the fertiliser queue, bribes of Rs 100-100 are being taken. In all the CHCs in the district, neither are doctors sitting properly, nor are people getting treatment. Similarly, people from the Transport Association demanded the establishment of a new transport city in the city. Divyanshi, who came to meet Rahul, said that we told him about the problem of competitive exams being cancelled due to cheating. He listened to it very carefully and assured that the Congress party will do whatever is possible. In the afternoon, Rahul left the MP residence to inaugurate the cricket tournament. Then he went to Municipal Chairman Shatrughan Sonkar's house. His daughter got married 8 days ago, which Rahul couldn't attend. Rahul met the entire family. He talked about cricket like a friend with the youngest member of the house, who was interested in the sport. This shows that Rahul can easily mingle with people of all ages. Rahul's tone remained very measured in MGNREGA Bachao Sangram Rahul reached a chaupal organised under 'MGNREGA Bachao Sangram' in Umran town of Unchahar, 50 km from Raebareli. Around 1000 women and men gathered here. Rahul attacked the Modi government over changes in MGNREGA, but his tone was very measured. Before Rahul's arrival, a brochure was also distributed to the villagers. It explained the difference between old and new laws in simple language. It also appealed to join the 'MGNREGA Bachao Andolan' through missed calls and QR code scanning. Amethi MP Kishori Lal Sharma also reached the chaupal with Rahul. He said - When state governments cannot give 10% funds, how will they give 40%? This is a conspiracy to end MGNREGA. Rahul began the Chaupal with greetings In the Chaupal, Rahul asked - How are you all? Then talked about MGNREGA. He said - Congress's Manmohan government brought MGNREGA, so that the scheme would run from the panchayat, not from the centre or state. This provided employment to millions of poor people, and roads, bridges, and ponds were built in villages. But, Modi ji mocked it in the Lok Sabha and is now slowly strangling it. Rahul mentioned the COVID period, when MGNREGA protected workers. But now the government wants to end it to benefit industrialists like Adani-Ambani. Three arrows from Rahul's quiver hit Modi government Rahul explained the changes in MGNREGA in 3 points. First- Work guarantee is being taken away. The old law had a legal guarantee of 100 days for every family; work was available in every village. Now, work is only in villages chosen by the Modi government, with no guarantee. Second- Right to minimum wage eliminated. Earlier could demand work throughout the year and received legal wages. Now, no work during harvest season, wages are at the government's discretion. Third- Gram Panchayat has been sidelined. Previously, development work was done through the panchayat. Support was received from mates and employment assistants. Now, arbitrary through contractors, no support. Additionally, 40% financial burden on states, which may stop work to save expenses. Is Rahul in 'restraint mode' after Bihar defeat? Rahul Gandhi's visit is not just about MGNREGA; it is being considered part of a strategy to sharpen Congress's rural politics. NDA's victory in the Bihar elections has made Rahul understand the risk of aggression. The alliance with Tejashwi Yadav failed there. Congress's 'Angry Young Man' image did not connect with voters. Now, Rahul wants to be seen following the 'Priyanka model' of politics. Very measured attacks, rural connect and talk of the constitution. He said - BJP wants to end the constitution. They want to break the third link of democracy by weakening panchayats. This is RSS's thinking. They want to erase Gandhi and Ambedkar. They want to take rights from the poor and give them to Adani-Ambani. Senior journalist Vijay Pratap Singh says - There was the SIR issue in Bihar. Then the subject was such that Rahul had to show aggression. But here the matter is related to subjects like MGNREGA. The crisis before Congress is that it does not have grassroots workers. In such a situation, Rahul has to play this role as well. If the organization was strong, they would have done this work, and Rahul Gandhi would have tried to make it a people's movement. However, here is the disadvantage of not having an organisation. The state president of Congress's NSUI gets beaten up by the police in Varanasi. But, UP Congress cannot even make it an issue. This is the real weakness of Congress. Rahul's words showed effect on villagers The impact of Rahul's words was visible on the villagers, too. Mithilesh, who reached the village meeting, says - The old law should be implemented. The new law will try to take away our rights. The old law is the best. Datadin from Rohania said that whatever he said was correct. He fed us paan worth 5 rupees and gave us three bigha land. Phoolmati from Gauspur said that we poor people were earning some money by doing labour work. Now, by making a new law, our wages are being taken away. Overall, through his speech, Rahul appeared successful in making villagers understand that MGNREGA plays an important role in the rural economy. Especially during times of inflation and unemployment. Although the Modi government may keep claiming that the changes were made to increase 'efficiency'. However, Rahul explained to the villagers that this is a path to 'privatisation' and that the old MGNREGA law was beneficial for them. Now BJP will have to find a counter to this. Otherwise, Congress will succeed in creating a new narrative against the BJP in UP, like in 2024.

stories.title: 5 family members found dead at home in Saharanpur:Accused mixes sleeping pills in water, shoots wife, sons, mother; records confession audio before committing suicide
stories.summary: 5 bodies of the same family were found in a house in Shashvat Bihar Colony of Saharanpur. Amin shot his mother, wife, and 2 sons in the head before committing suicide. On the night of January 19, Ashok mixed sleeping pills in the water purifier. After drinking this water, all four family members fell into a deep sleep, while Ashok stayed awake. After this, Ashok recorded an audio at 3:12 AM. In the 1-minute 18-second audio, he confessed to committing murder. Said - I made a very big mistake... I killed everyone. As soon as Ashok's elder sister Mohini heard this audio in the morning, she rushed to the house. That's when the horrific story of murder and suicide came to light. On January 20, 5 dead bodies were taken to Amin's village, Khari Bans, where all were cremated. Why did Amin kill the entire family? To find the answer, we spoke to family members, neighbors, and police officials. Read the ground report... Friends said - Ashok would see shadows, made entire family sleep in 1 room A crowd had gathered outside the house in Shashwat Bihar Colony. Everyone had the same question on their lips... how could a father kill his own sons? His friends told us - he often talked about a shadow that only he could see. He called it the 'shadow of death'. He would also tell family members what would happen to them if he died. Due to this fear, despite having 3 rooms in the house, the entire family was forced to sleep in one room at night. Friends' statement is also confirmed by the fact that police found 5 bodies in the same room. Family members said Ashok was undergoing treatment in Chandigarh. He had gone into depression after the COVID period. In this massacre too, it is believed that Ashok started feeling that he was going to die. That's why he first killed the entire family, then ended his own life. First shot his wife, elder son, then mother, younger son had woken up Ashok's wife Anjita, mother Vidyavati, and sons Kartik and Dev were shot in the forehead. 3 country-made pistols were found on the ground among the bodies. SSP Ashish Tiwari says - these weapons cannot be licensed. Everyone was shot from point-blank range (close). Bullet marks were found on Ashok's chest and forehead. After examining the crime scene, he said - 10 rounds were fired from 2 pistols. Ashok first shot his wife and then his elder son. After this, he came to his mother and shot her. The medicine had less effect on the younger son, so he woke up. He was just getting up when Ashok shot him, too. The police theory also matches the crime scene, as only the younger son's body was found face down. The SSP claims that Ashok killed everyone in just 40 seconds. Blood was scattered on the floor. The cot, bed sheet, and pillows were also found stained with blood. However, no items were found scattered in the room. Three 1.5-minute audios, shared bank details After killing the entire family, Ashok recorded three 1.5-minute audio recordings on his mobile. In these, he explained to his sisters about bank accounts, Paytm, and where the money is kept. He also mentioned important PIN cards. In one audio, Ashok said, "Sister, I have paid all the installments for the mobile phone that I bought for my nephew. Don't worry now." Now read the voice message that Ashok sent to his sister Mohini before dying.... At 3:12 AM, a voice message was sent to Mohini's mobile. She also lives in Shashwat Bihar Colony, not far from Ashok's house. She heard this message after waking up in the morning. In this WhatsApp message, Ashok said- Sister... I have made a very big mistake. I shot and killed mother, your sister-in-law and both sons. Now I am also committing suicide. Sister, perform my last rites in village Khari Bans. Whatever property I have, you two sisters divide it between yourselves. After this, Ashok said something else in broken lines, but the police were unable to understand it. The cyber cell is also trying to clear this audio. Water samples from purifier sent for testing Police found a water purifier installed in the kitchen. Sleep medication wrappers were also found near it. Samples of water from this purifier have been sent for forensic examination. Additionally, samples were taken from water bottles and glasses, with the remaining water kept in the room. The SSP said - During treatment from the Chandigarh doctor, the medicines prescribed to Ashok included sleeping pills. We believe those same medicines were mixed in the purified water. These facts will be proven once the sample reports come back. Father died under suspicious circumstances one day before retirement According to friends and neighbors, 3 years ago, Ashok's father, Surendra, died under suspicious circumstances. He died just one day before his retirement. Since he was employed at that time, Ashok got the job of an Amin under the deceased dependent quota. During the COVID period, Ashok fell ill, after which he went into depression. He was also getting treatment in Saharanpur. He was troubled due to 2 reasons- 1. Ashok had started seeing shadows at night, so despite having 3 rooms in the house, he made the whole family sleep in just 1 room. He wouldn't let anyone go into the other rooms. 2. Ashok wanted to stay in village Kharibans, while the family was insisting on living in Saharanpur city. This was also causing disputes. Former village head Rajendra stated that the house was locked from the inside, and relatives had to use a ladder to enter, ruling out the involvement of any outsider. He said Ashok was suffering from depression, but it is hard to believe it led to such an extreme act. Ashok’s brother-in-law, Devesh Singh, said the family tried calling him repeatedly in the morning, but he did not answer. When his son reached the house, it was locked. With help, they entered and found all the bodies lying on cots and beds. Neighbours described the family as quiet and peaceful, with no known disputes. Dev was a Class 9 student, and Kartik studied in Class 10. People are still struggling to understand what happened overnight that wiped out the entire family. MP, MLA expressed grief Congress MP Imran Masood and BJP MLA Mukesh Chaudhary reached the spot after receiving information about the incident. Both called the incident tragic and demanded an impartial investigation. DIG Abhishek Singh said - The house was sealed after the forensic team collected evidence. Now waiting for the post-mortem report.

stories.title: Wife kills husband with sons in Lucknow:Brother says man is beaten with sticks, body crushed and thrown 1 KM from home
stories.summary: In Lucknow, a 50-year-old man was beaten to death by his wife and sons. His body was found in a pit about 1 km from his home on Tuesday morning, after locals informed the police. The deceased was identified as Arjun Pal. The police have taken his wife and sons into custody based on a complaint by the deceased’s brother. He alleged that they attacked Arjun Pal with sticks and rods and then dumped his body in the pit to make it look like an accident. The incident happened in Kharta village, under Malihabad police station. Seeing a body in the pit, the police were informed Local people saw a body in a pit near the Nabinagar canal bridge in the Malihabad police station area on Tuesday morning around 10 AM. Local people informed the police about it. When the police, who arrived on receiving the information, started investigating, the deceased was identified as Arjun Pal, a resident of Kharta village. The deceased's brother, Munnu Lal, said- I immediately reached the spot upon receiving the information. An e-rickshaw was lying on top of my brother Arjun Pal's body. There were injury marks on his face. Also, nearby, a steel tank and a blood-stained bed were lying. Wife and sons killed the brother Based on my suspicion and for investigation, the police also reached brother Arjun Pal's house. There, bloodstains were found in the room. Arjun's wife and both sons crushed his face and murdered him. To make this murder look like an accident, the body was thrown into a pit about 1 kilometer away from the house. An e-rickshaw was dropped on top of it. Seen going by e-rickshaw at 3 AM Brother Munnu Lal said that Arjun's two sons are addicted to alcohol and gambling. Late on Monday night, both sons had assaulted their father Arjun Pal. According to villagers, an e-rickshaw was seen leaving the village around 3 AM on Tuesday night, but due to darkness, the people inside could not be identified. Malihabad Inspector Surendra Singh Bhati said that based on the brother's complaint, the wife and both sons have been taken into custody. Initial investigation suggests that the body was taken by e-rickshaw and dumped to make it look like an accident. Bloodstains have been found in both the room and the e-rickshaw. We are investigating from all angles.
