She spoke about her recent extended stay on the ISS, the challenges faced, and the growing commercialization of space. Williams also highlighted the importance of international cooperation in space exploration and inspired Indian students to pursue careers in the sector.

stories.title: ED writes to Tamil Nadu govt seeking FIR against minister
stories.summary: The Enforcement Directorate has urged the Tamil Nadu government to file an FIR against Minister KN Nehru, alleging Rs 366 crore in money laundering linked to corruption in official transfers within the Municipal Administration department. This marks the third such communication from the ED in three months, citing evidence of bribery and tender rigging.

stories.title: CAT quashes CBIC charges against Sameer Wankhede
stories.summary: The Central Administrative Tribunal has cleared IRS officer Sameer Wankhede of disciplinary charges. The tribunal found the charges framed by the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs to be retaliatory. It observed that the action appeared to be an attempt to stall Wankhede's promotion.

stories.title: US ambassador Sergio Gor: Will ensure senior US officials visit India regularly
stories.summary: US Ambassador Sergio Gor pledged regular visits by senior US officials to India to elevate their partnership. This follows a productive visit by Senator Steve Daines, who met with Indian ministers and business leaders. Daines advocated for Montana's pulse crop farmers, urging favorable provisions in future trade agreements with India, the world's largest consumer.

stories.title: Vinod Tawde to be BJP's Kerala poll in-charge
Congress slams BJP: You pick president first, then say there’s a poll
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi's use of the term 'urban Naxals' has drawn sharp criticism from the Congress party. The Congress pointed out that the Home Ministry itself does not use this phrase. They questioned if the Prime Minister considers anyone opposing him an 'urban Naxal'.

stories.title: Rule change: Lok Sabha MPs can mark attendance only from their seats
stories.summary: Lok Sabha MPs must now mark attendance from their designated seats during functioning hours, a change effective from the upcoming Budget session. Speaker Om Birla announced this reform to ensure attendance reflects active participation, not just presence within Parliament. This move aims to boost discipline and productivity in legislative proceedings.

stories.title: On Day 1, Nitin Nabin targets rivals in poll-bound TN
stories.summary: Nitin Nabin, in his first address as BJP national president, urged party workers to defend Sanatan faith and its legacy, stating that parties opposing traditions like 'deepam' in Madurai or Ram Setu have no place in politics. He also encouraged youth to actively participate in politics, viewing it as a long-term commitment.

stories.title: SIR: WB deadline may be extended by 10 days
DGCA: IndiGo has pledged not to cancel flights
Police summonses to journos a 'new low', say J&K parties
stories.summary: Political parties have strongly criticized police actions against Kashmiri journalists. They describe the summoning of reporters and demands for bonds as a "new low" and an attempt to intimidate and silence independent voices. This comes amid reports of journalists being questioned for their coverage of sensitive issues in the region. The actions are seen as a threat to press freedom.

stories.title: EC in SC: Art 324 needs to be read as including power of SIR
Time spent together 65 days; legal battle: 13 yrs & 40 cases
Voluntary contributions to BJP up 54% to Rs 6,125cr in 2024-25
stories.summary: The BJP's voluntary contributions surged by 54% to Rs 6,125 crore in 2024-25, significantly exceeding the Rs 1,686 crore earned via electoral bonds in the previous year. This increase, driven by a near three-fold rise in corporate donations, offset the loss of anonymous funding.

stories.title: Panama firm in SC over duty-free outlets in Noida International Airport
Government advises kin of Indian officials in Bangladesh to return
stories.summary: In response to escalating anti-India protests and potential violence in Bangladesh, India has advised families of its diplomats and officials stationed there to return home. This precautionary measure aims to ensure safety, though all Indian missions and posts in Bangladesh remain fully operational. The situation is temporary and will be reassessed.

stories.title: Monkey pox strain links Kerala cases to foreign travel: Study
stories.summary: A groundbreaking genetic study in Kerala has identified a more aggressive Mpox variant, Clade Ib, linked to international travel and ongoing human-to-human spread. Researchers found distinct mutations indicating the virus is evolving and adapting, suggesting faster transmission than older strains. This discovery underscores the urgent need for heightened surveillance and public health preparedness across India.

stories.title: Hyderabad-based AM group commits $25bn for AI infra hub in Noida
Canada prepares for a hypothetical attack from America for the first time in 100 years: 'Unlikely but...'
Pokimane speaks out on Grok AI controversy, citing past deepfake trauma
stories.summary: Popular streamer Pokimane expressed her exhaustion and pain over the Grok-AI backlash, drawing parallels to a past deepfake incident involving her. She highlighted the misuse of AI for creating inappropriate images of women, emphasizing the need for consent and protection in AI development. Pokimane's personal experience underscores the ongoing struggle with AI safety and the impact on victims.

stories.title: Big opening for US nuke energy firms under Shanti Act: Indian envoy
J&K: Op Trashi-I enters Day 3; hideout busted, few detained
stories.summary: Operation Trashi-I in Kishtwar's Chatroo region enters its third day, with security forces intensifying searches and aerial surveillance. A terrorist hideout was discovered, and locals were detained for questioning. The operation follows the death of Army Special Forces Commando Havildar Gajendra Singh during an earlier gun battle.

stories.title: Who is Cece? Twitch streamer at the center of Marvel Rivals Creator Cup controversy
stories.summary: Twitch streamer Cecee faced online backlash after a heated incident during a Marvel Rivals tournament. She insulted a teammate during a live match. Cecee later apologized, admitting her mistakes as team captain. She stated she reacted emotionally and failed to de-escalate the situation. The streamer promised to improve her leadership skills.

stories.title: J&K: IED detected on Srinagar-Baramulla highway; destroyed
Greenland PM asks residents to prepare for a possible invasion, says 'can't be ruled out'
Farooq rejects Mehbooba’s demand over Jammu areas as ‘Dixon Plan’, calls for reunification of Ladakh with J&K
Collin, Dallas, not Calcutta, Delhi...: Texas candidate's poll promise is to deport H-1Bs, 'assimilate rest'
From Red MAGA cap to mocking videos: Here's how Greenland responds to Donald Trump's threat
stories.summary: Thousands in Denmark and Greenland protested President Trump's demand to acquire the Arctic island, with many wearing parody MAGA caps. Trump responded by announcing new tariffs on European countries opposing his administration's control over Greenland, sparking further outrage among demonstrators.

stories.title: 'If I didn’t come along, there would be no ... ': Trump takes credit as Europe bristles over Greenland
stories.summary: Donald Trump claimed he single-handedly saved NATO, asserting the alliance would be defunct without him. Meanwhile, European leaders vowed an "unflinching" response to Trump's threats of tariffs over his bid to acquire Greenland, warning of a "downward spiral" in EU-US ties.

stories.title: Let's buy California from Trump: Danish satire petition collects signatures to counter US' Greenland move
Sunita Williams in Delhi: Nasa astronaut calls being in India 'homecoming'; shares life lessons from ISS
stories.summary: Nasa astronaut Sunita Williams visited India, calling it a homecoming. She shared her experiences aboard the International Space Station. Williams spoke about how seeing Earth from orbit fostered a sense of global unity. India has ambitious space plans, including its own space station by 2035 and a lunar mission by 2040.

stories.title: One year of Uttarakhand UCC: Over five lakh applications, no privacy complaints
Area around Kumbhalgarh wildlife sanctuary declared eco-sensitive zone
‘Did his wife sock him again?’: Why Emmanuel Macron wore sunglasses at Davos
stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron's decision to wear reflective aviator sunglasses during a Davos speech sparked widespread speculation, ranging from fashion statements to political statements. The Élysee Palace clarified that Macron had a "mild eye condition," later reported as a burst blood vessel, to explain the unusual accessory.

stories.title: India asks dependents of Bangladesh Mission & Post officials to return home, cites security situation: Report
'Don't fight, don't resist': Immigration attorney explains if ICE agents can pull you out of your car
Singapore at no. 1, India at 16 in Responsible Nations' Index
How Trump's leadership style compares to Obama, Reagan, or Nixon
stories.summary: That reaction itself is revealing. Trump does not see the presidency as a role shaped by inheritance, restraint, or continuity. He sees it as a personal contest, one in which dominance, visibility, and disruption are the metrics of success. To compare him with earlier presidents is therefore not just an academic exercise. It is a way of understanding how radically his leadership style departs from the American tradition.

stories.title: Punjab Police launch 'Operation Prahar'; raid locations linked to 60 foreign-based gangsters
Manikarnika Ghat row: Politics over demolition and clearing drive in Varanasi — what's the controversy
stories.summary: A political storm brews over Varanasi's Manikarnika Ghat, with opposition parties accusing the BJP government of damaging ancient heritage during a beautification drive. Claims of destroyed idols and temples have surfaced, while authorities deny wrongdoing, stating the work protects heritage and corrects neglect. FIRs have been filed against those allegedly spreading misinformation.

stories.title: AM Group to build $25 billion GW scale AI compute hub in Uttar Pradesh
stories.summary: The project, announced at the World Economic Forum 2026 in Davos, involves a total investment of approximately $25 billion. This hub is designed to handle global AI workloads and will be one of the largest investments in India's digital infrastructure to date.

stories.title: Delhi government to construct six lane elevated road in South Delhi at a cost of over Rs 1400 cr
stories.summary: The Delhi government's Finance Committee has approved the construction of a new six-lane elevated road in South Delhi, at an estimated cost of over ₹1,400 crore.

stories.title: Nitin Nabin takes charge as BJP president: What's at stake for PM Modi's 'boss' in party
National interest isn’t anyone’s monopoly, it’s a shared duty: Mohan Bhagwat
'Hunger Games-style fight for jobs': Massive layoff of government workers in Canada; only these officers won't be fired
Greenland: EU troops deployment draws Trump's ire; later admits it was 'bad information'
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump reportedly admitted to receiving "bad information" regarding European troop deployments to Greenland during a call with UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer. This follows Trump's threat of tariffs on eight European nations, linking the move to his demand for US control of the Arctic island. European countries stated their drills aim to counter Russian and Chinese threats.

stories.title: From FAFO to TACO - the terms that define Trump 2.0
stories.summary: Perhaps we should take the Kantian route and try to explain the world through terms. So here are some terms from the second Trump administration to try and decode what’s going on.

stories.title: '2026 Is the New 2016': Why everyone’s engaging in performative trend-hopping
stories.summary: The current obsession with “2016” isn’t really about the year itself, but about how a specific early Gen Z internet culture turned it into a shared, ironic reference long before it went mainstream. What began as a niche, coded way of remembering a feeling has since been diluted into a trend, stripped of context by celebrities, algorithms and media eager to explain something that was never meant to be explained.

stories.title: UAE signs four major defence deals worth AED880 million at UMEX & SimTEX 2026
stories.summary: On the first day of UMEX & SimTEX 2026, the UAE signed four major defence contracts worth AED879.785 million. Deals with EDGE Group and Diveco International cover unmanned vehicles, advanced aircraft, and remotely operated systems. Announced by Tawazun Council for Defence Enablement, the contracts strengthen local capabilities, foster technology transfer, and highlight the UAE’s growing role in advanced defence industries.

stories.title: CM Naidu 'misused' Davos visit for political gains: YSRCP leader
Noida techie death case: NDRF retrieves car from waterlogged trench after three days — video
'We are in Australia, get back to your own country': Indian-origin father claims racial attack in Sydney; no action taken because...
Sold-out hotels, packed flights: How India is becoming a global concert destination
What is the 25th Amendment—and why Trump’s Norway letter is reviving it
Dubai launches Zhongtong electric buses: Sustainable UAE transport that runs 280km on one charge
stories.summary: Dubai has launched Zhongtong electric buses, capable of 280km on a single charge, marking a significant step in its 2050 zero-emission transport strategy. This initiative, part of a larger 735-bus procurement, aims to electrify public transport, enhancing sustainability and passenger experience with advanced features. The move positions Dubai as a leader in green mobility within the Gulf region.

stories.title: Never a dull moment in Trump 2.0: Tariffs, airstrikes and a year that kept the world on edge
stories.summary: Donald Trump's second term has been a whirlwind of activity. He has commanded global attention through bold policies and a 'America First' approach. Tariffs, military actions, and ambitious territorial proposals have reshaped international relations. His administration has also implemented strict immigration policies. This era marks a significant shift in global dynamics.

stories.title: Justin Trudeau appears in Davos with Katy Perry; speaks on Trump, Canada, Greenland
Delhi air pollution: GRAP IV restrictions revoked; decision after slight improvement
stories.summary: Delhi-NCR's air quality has seen improvement, leading the Commission for Air Quality Management to revoke GRAP-IV restrictions just three days after their re-imposition. While the 'severe+' category triggered the ban, stages I, II, and III of GRAP remain active. This move offers some relief from the stringent pollution control measures.

stories.title: SIR 'harassment': West Bengal districts erupt in protest; forces deployed
stories.summary: Protests erupted in West Bengal districts over alleged harassment during electoral roll revision, with roads blocked and tyres set ablaze. The Supreme Court stressed transparency in the process, while demonstrators claim genuine voters are being unfairly targeted with "logical discrepancies" notices. Authorities have increased force deployment in affected areas.

stories.title: “Legal work made simple”: Dubai Police launches digital platform for lawyers
stories.summary: Dubai Police has launched a dedicated Lawyer's Digital Platform, enabling legal professionals to manage paperwork and track cases online 24/7. This secure platform, accessible via UAE Pass, streamlines legal procedures and enhances efficiency by centralizing seven specialized services. The initiative signifies Dubai Police's commitment to modernizing digital services for faster, more accessible legal processes.

stories.title: Evening news wrap: Nitin Nabin becomes youngest BJP national president; Trump warns of 200% tariff on French wine & more
'Did he leave his hair in Montecito?': Social Media shocked by Prince Harry’s 'alarmingly bald' look after London court appearance
stories.summary: Prince Harry's recent court visit in London sparked an intriguing online dialogue regarding his receding hairline, made all the more striking against a throwback image Meghan Markle posted showcasing him with a luscious head of hair.

stories.title: “Virtually banned everywhere”: Sneako reportedly banned from US hospitality groups after anti-Semitism allegations surface
stories.summary: Sneako is facing fresh backlash after a promoter claimed on livestream that the streamer has been banned from nearly all US hospitality groups due to racist and anti-Semitic remarks. The confrontation went viral as the promoter cut personal ties with Sneako. The claims surfaced shortly after an IRL stream in Miami sparked outrage and venue condemnation.

stories.title: How powerful is Mohammed bin Salman compared to other Gulf royals?
stories.summary: Mohammed bin Salman, Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince, has consolidated immense power, becoming the de facto ruler. His influence, amplified by the vast Public Investment Fund, extends regionally and globally. While a key peer, UAE's Mohammed bin Zayed, presents a rivalry, MBS's control over Saudi Arabia's economic and political levers makes him the Gulf's most dominant royal.

stories.title: Chagos Islands deal: Why is US worried about UK handing over Diego Garcia to Mauritius — Explained
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump has sharply criticized the UK's decision to transfer sovereignty of Diego Garcia to Mauritius, calling it an "act of total weakness." This move, which secures a long-term lease for a vital US military base, has reignited debate over the strategically important island. The deal involves significant annual payments from the UK to Mauritius.

stories.title: Blue Davos: Water security now central at Davos; economic risks drive shift
'Decision at right time': DK Shivakumar's brother namedrops Rahul Gandhi in CM row; Siddaramaiah puts it to 'high command’
stories.summary: Speculation over the Karnataka chief minister post continues. DK Shivakumar's brother said that Rahul Gandhi assured a decision would be made at an "appropriate time". Shivakumar is reportedly exercising restraint for party unity. The upcoming legislative session may offer clarity. Meanwhile, Chief Minister Siddaramaiah remains open to discussions in New Delhi.

stories.title: ‘8 years later’: UK approves massive Chinese embassy in London— why was it delayed
stories.summary: London has greenlit a massive new Chinese embassy at Royal Mint Court, concluding years of debate. Despite security concerns from lawmakers and activists over potential spying and intimidation, the government approved the £225 million project. This decision aims to facilitate diplomatic ties and a potential visit by prime minister Starmer to China.

stories.title: 'Where is the election?' Congress' swipe after Nitin Nabin takes over as BJP chief; RJD joins criticism
“Willing to blame the wives”: Internet erupts after Perez Hilton reacts to Brooklyn Beckham’s explosive claims
stories.summary: Perez Hilton reacted strongly after Brooklyn Beckham publicly addressed his estrangement from David and Victoria Beckham on Instagram. Brooklyn blamed long-standing family control, alleged interference in his wedding to Nicola Peltz, and media narratives for the rift. Hilton said Brooklyn “exposed his family,” comparing the situation to Prince Harry’s experience and sparking widespread online debate.

stories.title: No wires, no plugs, just power through the air: How Finland is experimenting with wireless electricity
Oman’s new auto insurance rules: Insurers to pay drivers for delayed car repairs
stories.summary: Oman's motor insurance sector is undergoing a major reform, mandating insurers to compensate drivers for delayed car repairs beyond a 30-day deadline. This groundbreaking move, a first in the Gulf, also introduces staged payments for workshops and expanded coverage for natural disasters. Policyholders now have more protection and flexibility, potentially setting a new regional standard.

stories.title: Tejashwi Yadav vs Misa Bharti? RJD national executive meeting on Jan 25; to decide 'working president'
'Committed contempt': SC criticises Maneka Gandhi on remarks on stray dogs order; and makes a 'Kasab' reference
UN HQ razed in Jerusalem: Israeli forces move in with bulldozers; action termed ‘unprecedented’
Mic switched off, 'misleading' statement: Governor stages walkout—how the Tamil Nadu assembly drama unfolded
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu Governor R N Ravi walked out of the Assembly without delivering his customary address, citing "inaccuracies" in the DMK government's prepared text. Chief Minister M K Stalin condemned the act as a violation of rules and an insult to the House. Stalin vowed to seek constitutional amendments to remove the Governor's address mandate.

stories.title: Dubai ahead of Ramadan 2026: What’s changing for parking, Salik, schools, work life
stories.summary: Dubai is gearing up for Ramadan 2026 with adjusted Salik toll timings, reduced paid parking hours and shorter work and school days. These changes aim to ease daily routines for residents and visitors during the holy month, reflecting a blend of spiritual observance and practical convenience. Shorter fasting hours are also anticipated, making the period more manageable.

stories.title: Kerala: Row over governor’s address in assembly — what happened
stories.summary: Kerala governor Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar omitted and added to the state cabinet-approved policy address, drawing sharp criticism from chief minister Pinarayi Vijayan. The chief minister urged the speaker to consider only the cabinet-approved version as the official record. A similar incident occurred in Tamil Nadu where the governor walked out after refusing to read the prepared address.

stories.title: World’s largest purple star sapphire ‘Star of Pure Land’ unveiled in Sri Lanka with $300 million value
After Greenland, Trump eyes Diego Garcia in Indian Ocean
stories.summary: President Trump's criticism of the UK potentially returning Diego Garcia to Mauritius, a move backed by India, has escalated. This island hosts a vital US military base. India, with its own security interests in the Indian Ocean and historical ties to Mauritius, is supporting the decolonization process, offering significant aid for the archipelago's development.

stories.title: ‘Expose them to public’: PM Modi targets parties ‘protecting’ illegal immigrants; flags ‘threat’
stories.summary: Without naming any political party, but in an apparent attack on Trinamool Congress (TMC), which rules the poll-bound West Bengal, PM Modi lashed out at parties "covering up for illegal immigrants" and said: "We must expose them to the public". ​PM Modi also said the world doesn't question the "wealthiest and most powerful countries" when they crack down on illegal immigrants.

stories.title: Prince Harry’s friends were ‘good source of leaks’: Privacy case takes shocking turn in London High Court
stories.summary: Prince Harry is suing Associated Newspapers Ltd for alleged unlawful information gathering, including phone hacking and snooping. The publisher's defence argues that many leaks originated from Harry's own friends and social circle, a claim that Harry's legal team contends is a smokescreen for illegal acts. This defence highlights the complex intersection of celebrity privacy and media sourcing in the digital age.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia raises saudization to 60% in marketing and sales jobs with minimum wage of SAR 5,500
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development has raised Saudization rates to 60 percent for marketing and sales roles in the private sector, effective January 19. Establishments with three or more employees must comply within 90 days. Targeted positions include managers, specialists, and representatives, with a minimum wage of SAR 5,500. Support programs and guidance are provided to ease implementation.

stories.title: Over 1 lakh items forgotten in Dubai taxis: You won’t believe what people left behind; tips to get it back
stories.summary: Dubai's taxis saw a record 104,162 items lost in 2025, including over AED 2 million in cash, 35,000 electronics and 3,000 official documents. The RTA's efficient, multilingual system, utilising call centers, virtual agents and a smart app, ensures swift recovery, often within two hours, fostering trust in the city's mobility network.

stories.title: 'No going back': Trump posts image showing Canada, Greenland as US territory; what he told Nato chief
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump is set to push for acquiring Greenland at the Davos Economic Forum, citing Denmark's inability to protect the territory. He shared an image depicting Greenland as US territory and stated its acquisition is imperative for national and world security. Trump also mentioned a call with NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte regarding the Danish island.

stories.title: 'Nitin Nabin is my boss': PM congratulates 'millennial' BJP chief; calls himself a 'party worker'
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi declared Nitin Nabin his "boss" as the party worker after Nabin, the BJP's youngest-ever national president at 45, assumed office. PM Modi highlighted Nabin's millennial status, emphasizing his blend of youthful energy and organizational experience as crucial for building a developed India over the next 25 years.

stories.title: ‘Roads kill, bridges kill, fires kill’: Rahul Gandhi reacts to Noida techie death; levels ‘TINA’ charge at govt
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi's 'TINA' jibe, meaning 'There Is No Accountability,' targeted the government following a techie's tragic death in a Greater Noida pit. The 27-year-old engineer's family claims repeated warnings about the accident-prone site were ignored. Authorities have filed an FIR against developers and formed an SIT to investigate the incident and rescue delays.

stories.title: Love Is Blind, Habibi to Dubai Bling: Netflix drops boldest Arabic originals for 2026 and fans can't keep calm
stories.summary: Netflix is set to launch a diverse Arabic entertainment lineup in 2026. Fan favourites like 'Love Is Blind, Habibi' and 'Dubai Bling' return. New films and series including 'From the Ashes: The Pit', 'Chasing Shadows' and 'Obsess' will also be available. This slate highlights Netflix's commitment to regional storytelling and Arab talent on a global scale.

stories.title: From party worker to its president: Nitin Nabin becomes BJP's youngest chief — 10 things to know
stories.summary: Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leader Nitin Nabin on Tuesday assumed charge as the party's new national president, marking a key transition in the ruling party's organisational leadership. The swearing-in ceremony was attended by Prime Minister Narendra Modi along with several senior party leaders. BJP chief ministers, national office-bearers, state unit presidents and members of the party’s national executive were also present at the event held in the national capital.

stories.title: Punjab government approves modernisation of bus terminals in five districts
stories.summary: Punjab is set to modernize its major bus terminals in Ludhiana, Jalandhar, Sangrur, Patiala, and Bathinda through a Public Private Partnership. This initiative aims to significantly enhance passenger facilities, safety, and overall efficiency at these vital transport hubs. The upgrades will focus on improved waiting areas, sanitation, accessibility, and integrated commercial spaces, ensuring better connectivity for millions daily.

stories.title: Tobacco puts 1 in 10 at oral cancer risk among Nicobarese in India
stories.summary: A study on Car Nicobar Island revealed that nearly 10% of Nicobarese adults have oral lesions potentially leading to cancer, primarily linked to high smokeless tobacco and alcohol consumption. Researchers found these concerning rates concentrated within this specific community, highlighting urgent needs for targeted screening and cessation programs.

stories.title: Hope against Chikungunya: ICMR steps in as cases rise across India
stories.summary: The Indian Council of Medical Research is fast-tracking an experimental RNA-based antiviral therapy for Chikungunya, inviting Indian companies to develop and manufacture it. Developed by ICMR's National Institute of Virology, the therapy showed complete viral suppression in pre-clinical studies by targeting essential viral genes.

stories.title: “Completely unfounded”: UAE Ministry of Defence denies Yemen Riyan Airport weapons allegations
stories.summary: The UAE Ministry of Defence has firmly rejected allegations of weapons, explosives, and secret prisons at Riyan Airport in Mukalla, Yemen. The Ministry confirmed that all Emirati forces and equipment withdrew from Yemen on 2 January 2026. Officials called the claims unfounded and politically motivated, emphasizing that the facilities in question are standard military structures with no hidden purpose.

stories.title: Alcohol, sugary drinks stay cheap in India as WHO flags weak taxes in South-East Asia
stories.summary: The WHO warns that alcohol and sugar-sweetened beverages are becoming more affordable in India due to weak tax designs, failing to curb consumption despite strong health links. This public-health failure is leading to rising rates of liver disease, diabetes, and other chronic illnesses, particularly among younger populations.

stories.title: Abu Dhabi crowned World’s Safest City for 10th straight year: How the UAE capital does it
stories.summary: Abu Dhabi has once again been crowned the world's safest city for the tenth year running, according to the latest Numbeo Global Safety Index. This remarkable achievement highlights the UAE capital's consistent dedication to public safety through advanced technology, proactive policing and strong community engagement, ensuring residents and visitors feel secure at all hours.

stories.title: High drama in Tamil Nadu assembly: Governor R N Ravi walks out; alleges 'national anthem insulted'
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu Governor RN Ravi staged a walkout from the state assembly, citing disrespect for the National Anthem and his microphone being switched off. Raj Bhavan alleged the speech ignored critical issues like Dalit atrocities. This marks a repeat of a similar incident last year, intensifying political tensions ahead of upcoming elections.

stories.title: Delhi to launch unified emergency helpline 112 for faster response: CM Gupta
stories.summary: Delhi residents will soon dial a single emergency number, 112, to access police, fire, ambulance, and disaster management services simultaneously. This unified system, ERSS 2.0, will also allow alerts via a mobile app, emergency button, SMS, and online platforms, automatically detecting caller locations for faster response.

stories.title: Saudi second semester schedule revealed: 92 school days with Ramadan adjustments and multiple breaks
stories.summary: The Ministry of Education has revealed the full schedule for Saudi Arabia’s second semester. The semester will span 92 school days, with adjustments during Ramadan, and includes three breaks totalling 28 days. Official holidays feature Founder's Day, Eid al-Fitr, and Eid al-Adha, with some regions observing holidays earlier. Summer vacation begins after the semester ends, with regional variations.

stories.title: 'Make America go away': MAGA has a new meaning in Greenland; how protesters are mocking Trump through caps
stories.summary: Danish and Greenlandic protesters are using "Make America Go Away" caps, a parody of Trump's MAGA hats, to voice opposition to his Greenland acquisition ambitions. These symbolic hats, gaining traction online and at rallies, highlight a united front against perceived US threats to Arctic security and Danish sovereignty. The movement underscores a strong desire to support Greenland.

stories.title: Iran unrest: Protests death toll crosses 4,000, state TV hacked - top developments
stories.summary: Iran grapples with its worst crisis in decades amidst widespread protests, a brutal crackdown, and an ongoing internet shutdown. State TV broadcasts were disrupted, showing support for an exiled prince. Thousands are reported dead, with fears of executions rising. International pressure mounts as Iran faces a Davos snub, while US aircraft carrier movements near the Middle East heighten regional tensions.

stories.title: Big boost for UAE–Philippines travel: Emirates adds 4 new weekly Dubai–Manila flights
stories.summary: Emirates Airline is significantly expanding its Dubai-Manila route, adding four weekly flights starting April 2, 2026. This move boosts travel options for holidaymakers, business travellers and the large Filipino diaspora, while also enhancing cargo capacity for vital trade. The expansion strengthens UAE-Philippines economic ties, offering improved connections to North America, Europe and the Middle East.

stories.title: Russia witnesses record winter: Entire neighbourhoods buried under mountain of snow — watch
stories.summary: Kamchatka Peninsula in Russia is grappling with unprecedented snowfall, burying homes and roads under metres of snow. Record-breaking storms have paralyzed daily life, with drifts reaching up to five metres. Authorities have declared a state of emergency after two fatalities, and avalanche risks are high. Transport remains severely disrupted as residents battle extraordinary winter conditions.

stories.title: Iran barred from Davos: WEF says it's 'not right' for Tehran to attend; cites 'tragic loss of lives'
stories.summary: Iran has been gripped by unrest since late December, when demonstrations driven by economic grievances spread rapidly across the country. The protests were widely viewed as one of the most serious challenges faced by the Iranian leadership in recent years. Authorities responded with a sweeping crackdown, accompanied by a communications blackout that began on January 8.

stories.title: 'Will act with a force it has not yet known': Israel’s stark warning to Iran; what Netanyahu said on US
stories.summary: Israel's Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu issued a stark warning to Iran, promising an "unprecedented" response to any attack. He stated Israel is closely watching Tehran, hinting at irreversible consequences. Meanwhile, the US is reportedly moving a carrier strike group towards the Middle East amidst rising tensions.

stories.title: Nitin Nabin sole candidate in fray for BJP president’s post, all set to take over today
stories.summary: Nitin Nabin is set to become the BJP's national president, emerging as the sole candidate with widespread backing from top party leaders, including PM Modi. This marks a historic moment as the party's president has always been a consensus choice.

stories.title: UK court seeks Delhi HC help in Nirav Modi’s bank fraud case trial
HC refuses to suspend Sengar jail term in custody death case
stories.summary: The Delhi High Court denied suspended jail term for expelled BJP leader Kuldeep Singh Sengar in the custodial death case of the Unnao rape survivor's father. The court cited the grave nature of the offense, Sengar's criminal history, and the trial court's findings, emphasizing that the delay in trial was partly due to Sengar's legal team's actions.

stories.title: Abusive words alone not SC/ST Act offence: SC
SC directs govt to frame SOP for mentally ill homeless
SC seeks govt stand on AC rail fare cut for acid attack survivors
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has asked the government to respond to a Public Interest Litigation seeking concessional AC train fares for acid attack survivors.
